intro: "The Hills Have Eyes" is a quest in the Gustberry Lowlands where the beleaguered farmer Aamelia takes a stand against highwayman bandits. Adventurers launch a preemptive strike on an encampment in the northern hills to diminish the bandit forces before their leader, Ferauu, launches a raid.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.
Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

clips.title: Completion
paras: When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.
Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
